claims.rule: When changing middleware placement or composition, test that rejection does not execute the protected handler, and that handler-only transformations preserve routing/fallback decisions.
claims.applicability: Evidence spans ZIO 1 CSRF middleware (#542) and ZIO 2 handler/routing separation (#1916). Combining their invariants is an explicit synthesis, not a single reviewer statement; APIs and middleware application order differ by era.
claims.counterexample: CORS preflight, slash normalization, allow and unmatched-request metrics deliberately affect or observe routing. They should not be rejected merely for being more than a handler transformation; 403 status alone also does not prove short-circuiting.
